caption: : Avg. performance across 5 datasets (NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, HQA). Blue bars show performance with relevant context, while purple bars show performance without it. (w/) denotes .
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates average performance values across five datasets, comparing results with and without context. The horizontal axis displays two categories: "With Context" and "Without Context," with "With Context" appearing to the left of "Without Context." The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Three bars are present for "With Context," all rendered in blue, with approximate values of 60, 58, and 57, respectively. Three bars are also present for "Without Context," appearing in purple and having approximate values of 48, 46, and 45 respectively. There are circular data points plotted on top of each of the blue bars; the position of each circle indicates respective observed values, with a range from approximately 10 to 50. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order beyond their visual grouping by context type, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their respective color coding and the superimposed data points.
